items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Collaboration was “I’m Hip” that we did together, that was our song that we wrote jointly. And recently we have a two piano show that we’ve been doing.

ctx.x: Yeah, you guys have collaborated a number of times.

We haven’t collaborated that much but we’ve known each other for 40 years now and I’ve been involved in a lot of Bob’s projects. Let’s put it that way. Collaboration was “I’m Hip” that we did together, that was our song that we wrote jointly. And recently we have a two piano show that we’ve been doing. And we recorded it in front of an audience in L.A. and it’s on Blue Note. The show is called “Who’s on First.” And that’s the name of the CD.
All right. Do you have particular comedians that you like?
